data.name: ANAVASI
data.detailed_description:
ANAVASI is a story-driven, choice-based adventure that blends gothic atmosphere, psychological drama, and modern mystery.

You play as Jason, a game developer caught in the slow, almost invisible collapse of a life that once felt stable — his work, his routine, his sense of direction quietly losing their meaning. Then he meets Sofia: a woman who hides a secret older than the city itself.

Drawn into a hidden society of vampires that has shaped Athens from the shadows for centuries — a society fractured by old allegiances and colder politics — Jason is forced to confront truth, obsession, and the question of what a life is actually worth. Every decision carries him deeper. Toward understanding. Toward ruin. Toward something that cannot be undone.

Key Features

  • A ~10-Hour Cinematic Experience — A tightly authored narrative built for emotional impact and replayability, not padding.

  • Five Distinct Endings — Choices accumulate quietly and resolve decisively. Jason's fate — mortal, bound, or eternal — is shaped by what you do and what you refuse to do.

  • Modern Gothic Athens — Real streets, apartments, and the hidden spaces beneath them, rendered in atmospheric detail. A familiar city that grows subtly unfamiliar.

  • A Society Divided — The vampires of Athens are not a monolith. Old factions, older grudges, and a fragile political order the player slowly learns to read.

  • Dialogue That Matters — Conversations, silences, and small refusals reshape relationships and outcomes. Interpretation is part of play.

  • Featuring Professional Voice Acting — Performance-led storytelling that carries the weight of the script.

  • An Original Score of Melancholy & Desire — Modern ambient textures threaded with classical undertones.

content_descriptors.notes: Anavasi contains scenes of violence involving vampires, including biting and claw attacks that result in the death of victims. These moments are depicted with dramatic intensity but are not graphically gratuitous. The game also includes one non-explicit intimate scene between a couple, implying sexual activity without explicit nudity or graphic depiction.
